components.name: Numbered Index Row
components.description: Rule-bound service navigation pairing technical indices with condensed titles.
components.css: .ds-index{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2rem 1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:12px;min-height:56px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#f7f7f5;text-decoration:none}.ds-index span{color:rgba(247,247,245,.55);font:600 .65rem/1.2 monospace}.ds-index strong{font:800 1.1rem/1 Arial Narrow,sans-serif}.ds-index i{color:#4ef2f2;font-style:normal}.ds-index:hover strong{color:#4ef2f2}.ds-index:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #4ef2f2;outline-offset:3px}

narrative.overview: An industrial field manual meets an editorial feature: oversized condensed statements, precise rules and indices, alternating graphite and warm-white fields, and cyan reserved for meaningful signals.

rules.name: The Signal Rule
rules.body: Cyan identifies action, navigation, or a meaningful point in the story.

rules.name: The Clean Edge Rule
rules.body: Readable text never uses RGB splits, text shadows, filters, or transformed containers.

dos: Use one dominant typographic statement per section.
Keep supporting copy high-contrast and narrowly measured.
donts: Do not use chromatic aberration or blur on readable type.
Do not introduce generic SaaS cards or fake proof.
Do not use cyan for long small-text passages on light backgrounds.
